scenarios.criterion: The locations view's map imagery MUST come only from the app's own origin; no tile or image request MUST leave the page.
scenarios.name: Locations view loads map imagery from its own origin only
then: no network request is made to any origin other than the app's own
the map's imagery is served from the app's own build output, for example a same-origin request to /sword-coast-map.png

scenarios.criterion: The existing markers, territory polygon and popups MUST keep the same position relative to each other after the tile layer is replaced.
scenarios.name: Markers, territory polygon and popups keep their relative positions after the tile layer is replaced
given: the locations view has loaded with the local map imagery in place
when: the shop markers, the Sword Coast territory polygon, and their popups are inspected
then: the Waterdeep Branch marker stays at [45.0, -120.0]
the Sword Coast polygon still spans [-122.0, 48.0] to [-118.0, 41.0]
each marker, polygon and popup sits in the same position relative to the others as it did before the imagery changed

scenarios.criterion: Every test in tests/map.spec.ts MUST pass unchanged under the default Leaflet CRS.
scenarios.name: Map centre stays at the documented coordinates under the default CRS
then: the map centre stays close to latitude 45.0 and longitude -120.0

scenarios.criterion: Every test in tests/map.spec.ts MUST pass unchanged under the default Leaflet CRS.
scenarios.name: Zoom level 10 bounds include Waterdeep and exclude the southern boundary
when: the map is zoomed to level 10
then: the visible bounds include latitude 45.0, longitude -120.0

scenarios.criterion: Every test in tests/map.spec.ts MUST pass unchanged under the default Leaflet CRS.
scenarios.name: Geolocation pan moves the map centre to the user's location
given: the browser reports a geolocation position
when: the locations view requests the user's location
then: the map centre pans to latitude 47.6, longitude -121.1

scenarios.criterion: Every test in tests/map.spec.ts MUST pass unchanged under the default Leaflet CRS.
scenarios.name: Distance between Waterdeep and Baldur's Gate stays within the expected range
when: the distance between the Waterdeep and Baldur's Gate markers is calculated
then: the calculated distance stays between 300 and 400 km

scenarios.criterion: A Playwright test that aborts every request not addressed to the app's own origin MUST show the locations view loading, leaflet.waitForMapLoad() resolving, and leaflet.checkTileFailures() returning false.
scenarios.name: Locations view loads successfully with every off-origin request blocked
given: every network request whose origin is not the app's own origin is blocked
then: the page's map helper waitForMapLoad() resolves
the page's map helper checkTileFailures() returns false

scenarios.criterion: The new map image's licence MUST be recorded next to it, either as an original in-repo creation or under a licence that permits redistribution.
scenarios.name: The map image's licence is recorded next to the asset
given: the local map image exists in the repository
when: the image's licence information is checked
then: a licence record sits next to the image
the record either marks the image as an original in-repo creation or names a licence that permits redistribution

scenarios.criterion: Every new or changed function MUST have cyclomatic complexity below 7, every changed line MUST be covered by a test that can fail, and no file outside scope.paths MUST change except the run's own delivery record under docs/features/leaflet-local-tiles/.
scenarios.name: Changed code stays within complexity, coverage and scope limits
when: the implementation for this feature is complete
then: every new or changed function has cyclomatic complexity below 7
every changed line is covered by a test that can fail
no file outside scope.paths changes, except the delivery record under docs/features/leaflet-local-tiles/
